name: Ookibashi Rikka
source: During the day, she is a nurse who demonstrates excellent hygiene management and devotion to her work, which includes cleaning, washing, and wiping. Even though she is the youngest nurse she is the most dependable She is a tsundere and rebellious towards the protagonist which makes her worth the training.
